plain_language_conclusion: R1 的 Place Food pilot 只冻结了 4 个候选 seed，却要求收齐 4 条专家成功轨迹。实际第 3 个候选失败，因此固定池耗尽后只有 3 条成功轨迹，R1 按合同停止。这个结果说明 pilot 候选池设计得太紧，不是社会信息路线或模型效果失败；没有打开任何正式测试数据。

long_pipeline_delivery.stop_reason: global R1 pilot could no longer pass after Place Food exhausted its pool

r2_revision_rule: Keep four required pilot successes and all formal model/statistical gates unchanged. Use a new, disjoint twelve-candidate pilot purpose; do not reuse R1 pilot seeds. Freeze and hash the R2 implementation and seed contract before running any R2 pilot seed.
